statements.impact_statement: An UNMAINTAINED-crate advisory, not a vulnerability: Astral ended maintenance on 2026-11-03 and RustSec records no flaw and no patched version. `astral-tokio-tar` reaches the build only through `testcontainers`, which `ferrobridge-testkit` uses to start PostgreSQL and the reference CDR for the end-to-end tests (`cargo tree -i astral-tokio-tar`), and every other workspace member reaches it only as a dev-dependency through that test-support crate. The server binary and the console binary do not link it (`cargo tree -i astral-tokio-tar -p ferrobridge-server -e normal,build` is empty), so it is absent from the artifacts this document describes. Re-evaluate on the next testcontainers release.
